method: Viewed all eight final PNGs, including both full and zoom comparisons, both posterior corners and both convergence traces
fit_assessment: The 250-ms-cap curves improve common-window likelihoods and condition-wise CDF gaps in both groups, but their peaks remain too low and tails too heavy. Control passes the specified window/local-stability checks. ASD reaches the 1,000,000-step cap and remains provisional; its delay posterior is concentrated close to 250 ms.
checks: Control above ASD; blue/orange ASL 20/40 labels
Full and zoomed curves keep 0.25--1.5 s normalization
Actual retained stimulus frequencies and visible empirical/model peaks
Standalone plots display ASD unconfirmed status
Posterior corners show the 250-ms cap and strong lambda/T0/theta correlations
Readable titles/axes/legends/footers without overlap; PDF bounds checked independently
